description: This file defines classes related to post-mortem data and call stack information within the Thunder::PluginHost namespace, including JSON serialization support.

classes.name: CallstackData
classes.description: Represents individual call stack frame data including address, function, module, and line number.

classes.name: PostMortemData
classes.description: Contains post-mortem information including worker pool metadata and an array of call stacks.

classes.name: PostMortemData::Callstack
classes.description: Represents a call stack with an ID and an array of call stack frames.

methods.name: CallstackData()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing JSON container and members.

methods.name: CallstackData(const Core::callstack_info& source)
methods.description: Constructs CallstackData from a source callstack_info structure.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for copying and moving CallstackData.
